name: aibimtool
description: Design buildings as IFC4 BIM models from a brief, right from Claude.
long_description: AIBIMTool's AI architect turns a design brief into a real IFC4 BIM model: it researches the building type, asks the questions only you can answer, plans large work, then models storeys, walls, slabs, doors, windows, rooms, stairs and the roof, and changes the model when you ask. Download the IFC for Revit, ArchiCAD, BlenderBIM or Tekla, or look at a 3D or plan picture in the chat. Tools: create_building, get_project_status, send_message, approve_plan, continue_building, get_model_image, get_ifc_download, list_projects, stop_building and check_credits. Needs an AIBIMTool API key (Studio plan); every message is billed to your own credits and failed runs are refunded.

tools.name: create_building
tools.description: Start designing a new building from a brief; returns a project id at once (metered credits).

tools.name: get_project_status
tools.description: State, the agent's reply, its questions or plan; waits while the agent runs.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Answers, changes and follow-ups to a project's agent (metered credits).

tools.name: approve_plan
tools.description: The go-ahead for the agent's plan (metered credits).

tools.name: continue_building
tools.description: Go on after a run stopped at its time limit (metered credits).

tools.name: get_model_image
tools.description: A 3D or plan picture of the model (free).

tools.name: get_ifc_download
tools.description: Write the model as an IFC4 file (free).

api_key.title: AIBIMTool API key
api_key.description: Your aibim_sk_ key from aibimtool.com → Developers → API keys (Studio plan).
